quarterly_data.signal: 10-K supplier disclosure: ACM depends on a limited number of suppliers, including single-source suppliers, for critical components and subassemblies of its tools. It relies on Ninebell Co., Ltd. as the principal supplier of the robotic delivery system subassemblies used in its semiconductor capital equipment and on Advanced Electric Co. Inc. as a key supplier of valves. Some U.S.-based suppliers can no longer supply ACM Shanghai, ACM Korea and related entities because of BIS Entity List designations.
